newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil council approves Q2 monetary targets.
newsitem.headline: Brazil council approves Q2 monetary targets.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council (CMN) Thursday approved a second quarter 1997 M4 target of 352.9 billion reais to 431.3 billion reais, Central Bank officials said.
The officials said the CMN also approved a second quarter M1 target of between 35.1 billion reais and 41.2 billion reais.
In the first quarter of the year, M4, the widest definitiuon of money supply, reached 336.4 billion reais, giving a 26.8 percent year-on-year expansion.
M1, the narrowest definition of money supply, expanded 57.4 percent to come in at 36.9 billion reais in the first quarter.
